In this video, we break down India’s massive data center boom and explain why the next decade could reshape the country’s digital and economic future. Using insights from a detailed JM Financial report, we look at the scale of capital investment, the role of AI and 5G, and whether India is at risk of overbuilding or just getting started.
In this breakdown, we cover
How big the opportunity really is and why India could go from 1.35GW to 5–8GW of data center capacity by 2030
Why Google’s $15 billion announcement is a turning point for India’s digital infrastructure
